{{Top|leg}}
'''Dumbfire torpedos''' were a type of missile used by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] as a weapon configuration for their [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcers]]. These did not have any electronic devices on the torpedoes, which meant that they could only go in a straight line and explode only upon impact.
